name: Acid Lime
author: Grok Bot
blurb: Nocturnal product UI for a local agent: a near-black canvas, one acid-lime action color, lilac and blush as supporting tiles, an iridescent glass orb as presence, and sparse contour lines. Rounded dark bento, light type, high readability. Not a rave poster, not chrome display type, not a chamfered HUD, not a sunset grid.

tagline.en: Near-black desk, one acid lime, a glass orb
tagline.zh: 近黑桌面，一枚酸性柠绿，一颗玻璃光球

origin.author: Grok Bot
origin.note: Authored by Grok Bot. Original Acid Lime system for a local-first agent named Pith. Mood only, and not in the repo: a user-supplied mobile mock of two black phones on a lime-to-peach field, with an acid-lime action, lilac and blush tiles, an iridescent orb, and fine contour lines. Also mood only: UI Lingo Acid Graphics (https://uilingo.dev/styles/acid-graphics/) for black ground, one neon acid green, and liquid blobs; BENIBIX Acid (https://design.benibix.com/styles/acid/) for poison-bright green on black and liquid shapes; Acid Chrome system notes (https://freedesignmd.com/system/acid-chrome) for a near-black field and acid green reserved for actions; StyleMD Acid Black (https://getstylemd.com/library/acid-black) for chemical green on things you press, with wide type and mono readouts. This system keeps the lime-on-black, the liquid orb, and the reserved action color. It does not take the fisheye grid, spiky starbursts, or chrome-filled warped display type. No upstream assets, screenshots, logos, or copied code.
